subject: Bulette
picture: A bulette bursts from loose dungeon earth. Official look: land-shark body with large armor plates, tiny eyes, wide mouth, four thick digging legs. A dorsal ridge along the back. Burst soil as large clods, stone ceiling, rock walls. The hole shows dirt outlines, not a black void. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
